air_and_flue_terms.reason: hot blast air, lance oxygen and the water vapour that leaves with the flue gas are not authored as exchanges, and the furnace gas that would carry carbon out of the boundary is not authored either. The consequence is a material account that is open on three of five nodes, reported with the residual terms below rather than closed by an invented coefficient.

balance_expectation.sign: positive, i.e. the model appears to output more mass than it takes in

explained_by.term: unported blast oxygen for the sintering breeze carbon
explained_by.derivation: (f - 1) x carbon of the coke breeze, with the published f = 3,664 t CO2/t C of ST-08; the oxygen comes from blast air that this model does not author

explained_by.term: published carbonate factor versus the atomic residue in the sinter
explained_by.derivation: CaCO3 mass x (0,440 published minus the atomic residue 0.4397118478108826409288012), modeling gap MG-S07

explained_by.term: unported blast oxygen for the furnace raceway carbon
explained_by.derivation: (f - 1) x raceway carbon of coke, PCI coal and injected gas

explained_by.term: unported blast oxygen for the methane hydrogen
explained_by.derivation: oxygen that ends up bound in the CO2 made from methane hydrogen, 2 x 15.999 / 16.043 x 8 kg of natural gas

explained_by.term: unauthored flue water of the injected natural gas
explained_by.derivation: combustion water of the methane hydrogen, negative because the model neither authors it as an output nor takes it in

explained_by.term: unported lance oxygen for the converter carbon
explained_by.derivation: (f - 1) x carbon burnt in the converter, i.e. hot metal and scrap carbon minus the carbon left in liquid steel

explained_by.term: unported lance oxygen bound in the converter slag iron oxide
explained_by.derivation: oxygen of the iron oxidised at the converter and held in the converter slag

explained_by.term: published carbonate factor versus the atomic residue in the converter slag
explained_by.derivation: converter CaCO3 mass x the same published-versus-atomic residue as the sinter term, modeling gap MG-S07

balance_expectation.residual_after_explanation: 1e-06 relative, i.e. the 0.000001 kg difference between 963.258900 and 963.258899 is the six-decimal rounding of the eight terms, not an unexplained flow
balance_expectation.acceptance: an MFA result must print the residual and all eight named terms; printing a closed balance, or a bare residual without the terms, both fail

undecided.item: the mass split of the exported furnace gas
undecided.effect: a plant that exports coke oven, blast furnace or converter gas leaves the boundary with carbon in it, which this model does not represent, so its mass account is read as open rather than as a complete physical loop

refusal_conditions: a mass sum that includes an MJ amount
a balance presented as closed while the air and flue terms are absent
an internal transfer counted on both sides of a total
a node closure whose authored in and out do not equal the graph ports of that node
